state.title: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charger Make-Ready Building Renovation Tax Credit
state.sum: The Sustainable Building Tax Credit (SBTC) provides a renovation tax credit for the purchase and installation of EV make-ready infrastructure at existing buildings. Residential properties are eligible for a $500 tax credit, increasing to $1,000 if the infrastructure is for an income-eligible resident.
